features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: When you join the College of Shadows at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in Stealth and in two other skills of your choice.

features.name: Mantle of Shadows
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, while in dim light or darkness, you can use an action to twist the shadows around you for 1 minute or until your concentration ends. For the duration, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can take the Dash action as a bonus action each turn.

payload.name: Mantle of Shadows
payload.description: While in dim light or darkness: concentrate for 1 min. Advantage on Stealth checks; Dash as bonus action each turn.

features.name: Cunning Insight
features.description:
Starting at 6th level, as an action, focus on a creature within 60 ft (WIS save vs your spell save DC). Can be used as a bonus action by expending Bardic Inspiration (subtract die roll from save). On failure, choose one:

* Advantage on your next attack roll vs the target
* Know target's damage vulnerabilities
* Know target's damage resistances and immunities
* Know target's condition immunities
* See through illusions on the target for 1 minute

features.name: Shadowed Performance
features.description:
Starting at 14th level, after performing for at least 1 minute, choose up to 1 + CHA modifier humanoids who witnessed the whole performance. Each makes a WIS save vs your spell save DC. On failure, choose one effect:

* Target believes your tale as truth for 24 hours and spreads it.
* Target believes someone nearby knows their darkest secret for 1 hour: disadvantage on CHA/WIS/INT checks and saves.
* Target is frightened of you (or an ally) for 1 minute; you/ally have advantage on attacks against it. Ends early on *remove curse* or *greater restoration*.

1/short or long rest.
